description: This Java source file defines the main class ZithShell for a command-line shell application. It sets up a Spring Boot-based shell environment with various configurations, includes commands to start and stop mock Zigbee core components, manages logging, and provides a prompt and status display for the shell interface.

classes.name: ZithShell
classes.description: Main configuration and entry point class for the shell application, setting up logging, context, and command beans.

classes.name: ZithShell.StatusLine
classes.description: Inner class responsible for managing and updating the status line displayed in the shell.

classes.name: ZithShell.ZithPromptProvider
classes.description: Inner class implementing PromptProvider to supply the shell prompt string.

classes.name: ZithShell.QuitCommand
classes.description: Inner class implementing a command to exit the shell.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that sets up terminal type, configures logging, initializes Spring context, and runs the shell.

methods.name: inputProvider
methods.description: Bean that provides InputProvider for the shell, integrating LineReader and PromptProvider.

methods.name: statusLine
methods.description: Bean that creates the StatusLine object to display status updates.

methods.name: configureLogging
methods.description: Configures logging framework, including logback and java.util.logging, with custom configuration.
